steps: Validate the request

candidates.description: A practice roadmap for learning request validation and separating business rules from HTTP.

candidates.title: Hexagonal Architecture with NestJS
candidates.description: Design a reservation service with a framework-independent core, explicit ports, and NestJS adapters. Make dependency direction visible across workspace files.

candidates.description: Build the file-level design of a retrieval-augmented answer service. Preserve source identity through chunking, vector retrieval, and citation assembly.

Make publication and deployment deliberate
candidates.title: Production Containers and Delivery Pipelines
candidates.description: Describe a repeatable container build and a gated delivery workflow in files. Connect a multi-stage Dockerfile, Compose services, and GitHub Actions without performing a deployment.

candidates.title: Designing Relational Schemas in PostgreSQL

steps: Define a resource and its operations

Finish the boundary with consistent failures
candidates.title: Building a REST API with Express and TypeScript
candidates.description: Write a small task API with explicit routes, input validation, and consistent error responses. Keep task rules separate from Express request handling.

steps: Turn a rule into a focused example

candidates.title: Practical Unit Testing with pytest

candidates.title: Server State with React and TanStack Query
candidates.description: Build a task-list interface whose server state has explicit query identities and mutation behavior. Describe cache invalidation and reversible optimistic updates in React files.

Make recovery settings part of the template

candidates.description: Design a queue-backed parcel event processor with explicit duplicate handling and failure recovery. Connect handler code to a least-privilege infrastructure template.
